quantity_rules: Use the corresponding foundation pile, cap and bracket counts.
Use steel bedframe HSS beam count.
Each follows steel bedframe bolt count; include 10% spare.
Floor-to-floor connection count; source minimum 250. Resolve 100 versus 250.
Wall wood-to-metal connection count; include 10% spare.
Wall angle connection count; include 10% spare.
Wall hold-down count; include 10% spare. EA = one complete hardware assembly.
Wall-to-wall connection count; plate design and quantity rule still need confirmation.
Truss connection / truss angle count respectively; include 10% spare.
Stitch piece count / roof purlin total length respectively; purlins include 5% spare.
Replace former roof slope area + 10% rule with a stud count / length / height takeoff.
Roof panel connection / roof rivet count respectively; include 10% spare.
Roof joint length; include 10% spare. Measure in linear feet.
Garage ceiling area; include 10% spare. Measure in square feet.
review_notes: The eight category pages replace the sequence-only layout. Stage labels remain as references: Foundation = 1; Panels = 2; all MEP and finishes = 3. Shared Site Setup serves all stages. Rough and Finish Electrical are adjacent on page 3.

Parts are installed components, including fasteners. Tools are reusable equipment and rentals. Consumables include applied foam, tape, sealant, abrasives and compounds. Items marked + are proposed additions, not source-confirmed requirements. Quantities, tool availability and exact products require trade review.

The handwritten vapor-barrier note says '6 mm plastic.' Confirm whether 6 mm or 6 mil was intended; this draft does not silently substitute a thickness. Confirm the 4/3 battery feed, 1-inch electrical conduit scope, screw lengths, Simpson clip models and roof-slope stud takeoff.

DD: define the interior-door and garage-door installation packages and the stretch-ceiling screws. Trade leads: confirm the proposed closet and cabinet installation components, 'toilet bottoms and trim,' and the 100-versus-250 floor-plate minimum.

Floor, wall-corner and truss-finish foam are pooled under Site Setup. Opening-specific foam remains under Windows & Doors. Fire-bell wire and sprinkler covers move to Fire Protection; window trim moves to Final Finishes. Magnetic clamps are referenced by utility crew, with shared stock counted once.

Based on all seven pages of Material_Package_Sequence_Compact_annotated (1) (1).pdf and the supplied edit summary. Original non-manual quantity rules are retained on page 9, with the obsolete slope-material rule explicitly flagged for replacement. New and unspecified items have no invented quantities. This is a category review document, not an approved purchase order.
